name: fullmla_0.2b_0830
hypothesis: First 0830v1 budget point on KDA + full causal gated MLA + AttnRes Full. Does it train stably at batch 16 x accum 2, and what does the frozen b0 panel read on it? Open assumption, flagged before the run: web_hq is 32.4% of this mix and it is not yet confirmed whether its build applied the quality head or only the pass1-3 regex layer, whose measured recall against hand-read garbage is 3.4%.
result: train 3.204 val 3.428, 497s, 7 cards; score matrix: domain NLL 3.6749, minimal-pair 0.682, ceval 22.5% (z=-2.1)
finding: INVALID as a scaling point. The web_hq domain (32.4% of the mix) was silently repointed: data/corpus/web_hq/ became 8 symlinks into the in-progress CCI3 build at 22:24, and /data00/tokens_web_hq.pt was rebuilt at 22:25 from those symlinks, 16 minutes before this run started at 22:41. The run therefore trained on CCI3, the corpus barred from every mix until its quality head is retrained (measured filter recall 1.7%, hand-read junk 30-39%). The original fineweb2 web_hq shards are gone from /work and /data00, and fineweb2 is absent from data/raw, so the domain cannot be rebuilt from what is on the box.
decision: Point 0.2b does not enter the scaling curve. Architecture and run mechanics are validated (stable loss, no NaN, batch 16 x accum 2 fits at 50.8GB/card), so the run is kept as a mechanics check only. Before any budget point is rerun, web_hq must have a known provenance and corpus_fp_matches must cover every mix domain, not one.
